title: Sessions and state: a chat that survives a restart

cards.title: A chat survives a restart
cards.text: The API keeps each session in a store behind one seam, and a restart resumes it where it was.

cards.title: One seam, two stores
cards.text: In memory, as today, or MongoDB: a setting picks one, and the session never knows which.

cards.title: A turn appended whole
cards.text: A document for how the session opened, then one per finished turn, never history rewritten.

cards.title: Resumed on its next message
cards.text: An id the API doesn't hold is read back, opened again the same way; a keyed chat still needs its key.

cards.title: 30 days idle, then gone
cards.text: SESSION_RETENTION, a TTL index deletes it; photos and PDFs are never stored.

cards.title: Azure DocumentDB, free
cards.text: MongoDB in the local compose, and a free-tier DocumentDB cluster for louis-agent.dev in main.bicep.
